atomic_facts.claim: Amazon VPC enables provisioning a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where AWS resources can be launched in a defined virtual network.
With Amazon VPC, AWS resources can be launched in a logically isolated virtual network that the user defines.

atomic_facts.claim: A subnet is a range of IP addresses in an Amazon VPC and must reside in a single Availability Zone.
